transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?

Well, I guess what brings me in is... I just don't have the push I used to have anymore. I used to go to choir, do my quilting, visit with folks. But lately, most days I just sit at home. I leave the TV on low. I know people are expecting me to be there, but I just... I don't go.
About how long have you been feeling this way?
I suppose it's been building up for a while. Mostly since I retired from the school office... that was a little over two years ago now.
Over these past two years, have you felt down or depressed most days?

No, I wouldn't say that. I don't really feel sad or... depressed. I'm not sitting around crying or feeling bad about things. It's more like... I just don't have the want-to anymore. But no, I don't feel down.
Have you or anyone close to you noticed any difficulties with your memory or thinking?

No, I haven't noticed anything like that. My memory is fine. I still remember everyone's names and everything I need to do... I just don't have the energy to go do it. But my mind is working just as well as it always has, and nobody has mentioned anything to me about it either.
Have you been diagnosed with any significant medical or neurological conditions?

No, I haven't. I'm pretty healthy, all things considered. I don't have any major medical problems or anything wrong with my brain... just the usual aches and pains of getting older, I suppose. But no big diagnoses.
Do you find yourself feeling physically exhausted or worn out even after doing small, everyday tasks?

No, I don't think so. My body feels okay. I mean, I don't get worn out or out of breath just from doing a few chores around the house. It's not a physical tired... like I was saying before, I just don't have the drive to get up and do things. But if I do them, my body holds up just fine.
During these past two years, have there been any periods lasting more than a couple of months where you felt completely back to your normal self?

No, not really. It's just been... well, pretty much the same this whole time. I haven't had any long stretch where I felt completely like my old self again. It just stays like this, day in and day out.
How has your sleep been over these past two years?

My sleep? It's been fine, really. I don't have any trouble falling asleep or anything like that. I just... well, I go to bed and sleep through the night mostly. I might wake up early sometimes, but it's just regular sleep, nothing out of the ordinary.
How has your appetite been over the past two years?
My appetite? Oh, it's been fine. I still eat my regular meals. I haven't noticed any changes with my eating or anything like that. It's just... just the usual, really.
Looking ahead, how do you feel about the future?

The future? I... well, I don't really know. I haven't thought too much about it, to be honest. I just take things one day at a time, I guess. I'm not really sure what to expect, so I just... I just focus on getting through today.
How have you been feeling about yourself and your self-confidence over these past couple of years?

About myself? Well, I feel alright, I suppose. I haven't really noticed any difference in my confidence or anything like that. I'm just... I'm just me, you know? I don't feel bad about myself, so I'd say it's been pretty much the same as it always is.
Over these past two years, have you had any trouble concentrating or making everyday decisions?

Trouble concentrating? No, I wouldn't say so. My mind works just fine for the day-to-day things. I can still focus on whatever I need to do, and making decisions hasn't been a problem. It's all just... normal, really. I haven't noticed any issues with that.
